candidates.tagline: NFL's throwback crest sailed through approval — then the whole internet spotted it
candidates.story: On October 22, 2026, the Atlanta Falcons posted a 1960s throwback crest graphic for their Week 7 game, featuring a black falcon against vertical red, black, and gold stripes — and fans immediately compared it to Nazi-era heraldry, generating millions of views and 'I did Nazi this coming' jokes.
candidates.why_funny: The design that apparently cleared every level of NFL and team brand approval looked, to millions of observers, unmistakably like something from 1930s Germany.
candidates.alt: The Atlanta Falcons 1960s throwback crest: a black falcon silhouette against bold red, black, and gold vertical stripes on a red background

candidates.tagline: Tesla wants to build 20,000 robots a week. First: the hands.
candidates.story: On October 21, 2026, Tesla announced it had started mass production of its Optimus humanoid robot in Fremont, CA — converting the Model S/X line — while Q3 profit fell 43%; but per The Information, the assembly equipment still isn't reliably lining up the robot's hand and joint components, and output remains hundreds per week, not the promised 20,000.
candidates.why_funny: The most ambitious humanoid robot program in history, backed by billions, is staking its future on the premise that hands are basically a solved problem — and they are not.
candidates.alt: A white and black Tesla Optimus Gen 2 humanoid robot at an outdoor event, its five-fingered articulated hand raised toward the camera while attendees look on
